visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands in a wide paved plaza, wearing a black long-sleeve bodysuit with high-cut leg openings and blue jeans. She holds a white Starbucks cup in her left hand and shades her eyes with her right hand, looking towards the camera. The background features a modern wood-paneled Starbucks building with its green logo and a clear, massive snow-capped Mount Fuji under a bright blue sky. A photographer's back and camera rig are visible in the bottom right corner. (2) The scene cuts to the woman sitting on a grey metal chair in the same plaza. She wears dark sunglasses and smiles broadly while looking slightly off-camera. The lighting is bright natural daylight. The Starbucks building and Mount Fuji remain the central background elements. (3) The woman is now standing in an asphalt parking lot area. She raises her cup high with one arm, smiling cheerfully. To her left, a white car is parked, and a green P-sign is visible. The wide-angle shot captures the entire Starbucks storefront and the mountain behind. (4) A wide panning shot focuses exclusively on the environment, showing the clean architecture of the Starbucks building and the unobstructed, majestic view of Mount Fuji. The ground is paved with square stone tiles, and small patches of dry yellow grass are landscaped around. (5) A montage of quick-cut shots shows the woman posing in various styles: sitting and leaning back, drinking from the coffee cup, standing with her hip popped, and smiling directly into the lens. The editing pace increases, synchronized with the upbeat mood of the scene.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice narrates in Mandarin, introducing the location with clear articulation. A gentle acoustic pop BGM plays in the background at a low volume. Faint outdoor ambient air is present. (2) A mechanical camera shutter sound effect triggers, marking a visual pose change. The narration continues, highlighting the beauty and photography potential of the scene with moderate energy. (3) The narration ends, and the BGM transitions into a high-energy Mandarin pop track featuring a female singer. The audio mix becomes brighter and more percussive, with a strong electronic drum beat and synthesized melodies dominating the remainder of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Comparison -> Proof -> Call to action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce and recommend a specific Starbucks branch in Japan as a superior photography spot for viewing Mount Fuji compared to the crowded Lawson convenience store, effectively promoting the cafe's unique location and scenic value.
